description: Hi, I'm Varad, a student from India passionate about programming, space technology, and problem-solving. I'm currently learning Java, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Git, and GitHub. For this challenge, I plan to build a Space Mission Design Game. I'm looking for teammates interested in web development, UI/UX, game development, data analysis, or space science. Beginners and experienced participants are welcome. Let's build something amazing together!
